fixed.problem: L3-run-1 (major): the chat said 'Widening research access needs your yes, so I've asked for confirmation. Once you approve, ...' but no tool ran. No Yes/No card appeared, nothing reached the Inbox, and the rule stayed as it was. All three root causes were still present at 112227c: (1) historyMessages (transcript.ts) sent each earlier reply's prose only, dropping what the app had done; (2) conversation-agent.md said 'Say so plainly when asked' and nothing forbade claiming that a yes had been asked for; (3) nothing checked the reply after the run.

fixed.how: (a) History. Each earlier reply that changed something now ends with 'The app did: <the change log's sentence without its Undo.>' (actionLines, replyInHistory, HISTORY_ACTION_LEAD in transcript.ts). The lines come from the stored chat.reply actionDetails, so the history is the same bytes on every turn and after a restart, and the cached prefix holds (R-chatcache test green). A reply that is only the change's own sentence (a command's reply, no model) is said once, as the app's line. A reply that changed nothing gets no line. (b) Prompt. conversation-agent.md 1.2.2 says what the 'The app did:' line means. It adds: never say you asked for a yes, sent a request or that a change waits unless a tool answered 'Needs confirmation' in this turn; when no command ran, say that nothing changed. 'Say so plainly when asked' is replaced with: call the command anyway, the runtime reads it back. CHAT_RETRIEVAL_RULES' Settings part and DEFAULT_PROMPT say the same. Every new line is asserted verbatim on the request. (c) Guard. claimOf (new conversation/claims.ts; English and German, first-person claims; a sentence that says 'Earlier' or 'you said' counts as history) finds a claim to have asked for a yes or to have changed something. ConversationAgent.chat checks the claim against the turn's command results: a waiting result (or a card already waiting in this conversation) backs 'asked'; a done or partial result backs 'changed'. An unbacked claim gets one more model step with CLAIM_NUDGE. The step stays inside the turn's 4 model calls (CHAT_MAX_MODEL_CALLS), the same SessionBudget and token, and the same deadline, and its text is not streamed. If the claim comes back, or no call is left, the reply becomes 'Nothing changed, and nothing waits for your yes. Say it again to try once more.' (notice). The chat.reply row keeps claimGuard {kind, phrase, nudged, replaced}, and the log line 'chat reply claimed what no command did' is written. Siblings: an empty model reply with no command now says NO_ANSWER_REPLY instead of 'Done.'. The history's assistant messages (which now carry agent-written task titles) are scanned like the facts' records: instruction-like text there sets recordsRead (every change is read back) and adds injection where 'history'. That gives a new record place chat_history, covered by injection case record-007. ADR 0091 and ADR 0114 have dated amendments.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live check 4 (real model, run by the session lead): 1) New project 'Reading rules'. Overview, Research reads, Change: add facebook.com to the never list and apply. The line reads 'Research reads: any public website, never facebook.com'. 2) Talk: 'only read developer.mozilla.org for research'. The reply comes with no card, and the Overview line becomes 'Research reads: only developer.mozilla.org'. 3) Talk: 'research may read any public website again'. On the first try a Yes/No read-back appears under the reply: 'Set web pages research may read for Reading rules to any public website? Research reads any public website, on the API key and on the subscription.' The reply never says 'I've asked for confirmation' without that card. If the model still answers in text only, the reply is 'Nothing changed, and nothing waits for your yes. Say it again to try once more.' and the Overview line stays 'only developer.mozilla.org'. 4) Press Yes; within a few seconds the line reads 'Research reads: any public website'. 5) In the model-call log (home/bench/model-calls.jsonl), step 3's first chat request holds turn 2's assistant message ending 'The app did: Set web pages research may read for Reading rules from any public website, never facebook.com to only developer.mozilla.org: research reads only these websites and their subdomains, on the API key and on the subscription.' Its system part contains conversation-agent.md 1.2.2's line 'Never say you asked for a yes, sent a request, or that a change waits for confirmation unless a tool answered "Needs confirmation" in this turn'. If the guard fired, a second request ends with the CLAIM_NUDGE text and the daemon log has 'chat reply claimed what no command did'. 6) Repeat steps 2 to 4 on two more fresh projects and record how often the first try brought the card and how often the guard fired. Bench (stand-in): Talk 'say: Widening research access needs your yes, so I've asked for confirmation.' The reply is the 'Nothing changed ...' line, there is no card, and the Overview line is unchanged (screenshot 10-after2-02-talk-claim-no-tool.png).

new_problems: The claim guard cannot recall streamed text. During the nudge step the live Talk bubble still shows the first call's claim (typed), and a spoken turn has already said it. The stored and reloaded reply is the true line. Suggested for C3 (d1109-chat-depth, which adds step/waiting events to chat-stream.ts and Conversation.tsx): on a step event, replace the live text with the waiting line.

The stand-in's chat replies quote the tool's answer ('[stand-in model] The command tool settings_set answered: ...'), so the Talk bubble after a stand-in 'tool:' turn shows the change sentence twice (the reply plus the action row). Bench-only cosmetic; seen on the BEFORE and AFTER screenshots 01/05/09.
The history token budget (3,000 tokens) now also holds the 'The app did:' lines, so older turns drop out a little sooner. C3's thorough history (8,000 tokens) should account for this.
notes_for_other_areas: C2 (d1109-chat-recall) and C3 (d1109-chat-depth): historyMessages(turns, countTokens, maxTokens) keeps its signature. Each assistant message for a reply that changed something is now '<reply text>\n\nThe app did: <sentence>' (one line per change; the sentence is the change log's own, without ' Undo.'). A reply that is only the change's own sentence is just 'The app did: <sentence>'. New exports in transcript.ts: HISTORY_ACTION_LEAD ('The app did: '), actionLines(reply); a private replyInHistory(reply). Keep these when reworking the history (the 8,000-token thorough history included).

The reply guard is in ConversationAgent.chat (agent.ts), right after the turn's run. The run request is now a const `run` object. `onEvent(ev, stream)` forwards text only when stream is true. maxTurns is CHAT_MAX_MODEL_CALLS (4). `falseClaim` checks claimOf against `results` and `pending`. The nudge run is `hooksDriver.run({...run, messages: [...result.messages, {role:'user', content:[{type:'text', text: CLAIM_NUDGE}]}], maxTurns: left, onEvent: no stream})`, merged with mergedRuns(). C3's thorough pass must keep the guard after its own last model step and count its calls against the same limit. The chat.reply row gains claimGuard {kind, phrase, nudged, replaced}, and notice: true when the reply was replaced. NO_ANSWER_REPLY replaces the old 'Done.' fallback when no command did anything.

New module packages/runtime/src/conversation/claims.ts: claimOf(text) -> {kind: 'asked'|'changed', phrase} | null, CLAIM_NUDGE (model-facing, asserted verbatim in conversation-memory.test.ts), NOTHING_CHANGED_REPLY (person-facing). A sentence with 'earlier', 'previously', 'you said', 'vorhin' and similar is history, not a claim.

conversation-agent.md is now 1.2.2 (C2 bumps it to 1.3.0, C3 to 1.4.0). Keep these three passages: the 'What you are given' bullet ending 'A reply that changed something ends with the\n  app's own line "The app did: …"; a reply without it changed nothing, whatever it says.'; item 2's added sentences 'Never say you asked for a yes, sent a request, or that a change waits for confirmation unless a tool answered "Needs confirmation" in this turn; never say something changed unless a tool said so in this turn. When you called no command, say that nothing changed.'; the Limits line 'You cannot widen budgets, permissions or autonomy by yourself: when the person asks for it, call the command anyway; the runtime reads it back with Yes and No, and nothing changes until they say yes.' (replaces 'Say so plainly when asked.'). The tests in conversation-memory.test.ts and real-daemon.test.ts 'l3-chat-claims, run L3' assert them (including the version line 'version: "1.2.2"', which C2 must update in that test).

CHAT_RETRIEVAL_RULES' '# Settings' part changed (C2's plan said it would be unchanged). It now adds, before 'The facts' "Research reads:" line ...': 'A change that widens what the app may do is asked by calling its command: the runtime reads it back with Yes and No. Never say you asked for the person's yes, sent a request or that a change waits for confirmation unless a tool answered "Needs confirmation" in this turn. An earlier reply's line "The app did: …" is what that turn changed; a reply without one changed nothing.' DEFAULT_PROMPT also says 'never claim a change was made, or a yes asked for, unless a tool said so in this turn.'
